## Description

Each receipt records batch number, expiry and quantity. Using stock takes the first-expiring batch unless the user picks one. An expired batch cannot be used.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Using stock defaults to the batch that expires first.
- [ ] **AC2.** An expired batch is shown as "Expired" in words and cannot be logged as used.
- [ ] **AC3.** Batch and expiry show on every movement.
